model.interpretation: The frozen primary result is unchanged; this diagnostic only quantifies residual structure after the result was already observed.

interpretation: The fixed global coefficient 0.8 underpredicts the 1 mm series and overpredicts the 2 mm and 3 mm series.
The 1 mm inferred values above one are physically incompatible with treating the published nominal aperture as a calibrated effective orifice, so they must not be used as a fitted correction.
Diameter-specific fitting would use the same holdout outcomes and is therefore prohibited for the primary claim.

The residual pattern is evidence that terminal aperture geometry, supply-line losses, valve opening and/or measurement interpretation must be represented before a transferable high-pressure release claim can be made.
claim_boundary: This post-access diagnostic does not establish a new validation result, does not fit parameters, and does not validate a station fueling loop, vessel transient, flame, radiation, dispersion or emergency response.
